# analysis/capture-senders.sh: which Windows module makes each send of the game family.
# Audit only: nothing is denied, nothing is hidden; loopback is not logged.
mode audit
protect \MapleStory.exe
protect \nexon_client.exe
protect \nexon_runtime.exe
protect \nexon_agent.exe
protect \DwarfAxe.exe
protect \CrashReportClient.exe
protect \grap-core64.aes
protect \grap-updater.aes
protect \grap-communicator64.aes
block-network on
network-default allow
network-loopback on
audit|message|proto=tcp|rights=send
audit|message|proto=udp|rights=send
